title: The Stopped Clocks
text: In the Forbidden City, a eunuch who served the last emperor shows you the clocks that all stopped at the same hour.

pass.text: The hour is not random. It is a date, and it is soon.

fail.text: You stare at the clocks, and for a moment your own heart stops too.

title: A Warlord's Banquet
text: A warlord with a taste for the occult invites you to dinner. Refusing is not an option.

pass.text: He is amused by you, and pays for your advice.

fail.text: He is not amused. His guards escort you out the hard way.

title: The Hutong Herbalist
text: An herbalist in a narrow lane sells remedies for the body and the mind.

options.label: News of the tremors in the west

pass.text: Her nephew drives a truck through the Gobi. He saw something.

title: The Ancient Observatory
text: Bronze instruments on the old city wall still track the stars. The keeper says they have been moving on their own.

pass.text: You reset the instruments to the true sky. Somewhere, something sleeps a little longer.

fail.text: The instruments point at something you cannot see.
